ayahs.textEnglish: BEHOLD, from on high have We bestowed this [divine writ] on Night of Destiny.
And what could make thee conceive what it is, that Night of Destiny?

ayahs.textArabic: لَيْلَةُ الْقَدْرِ ەۙ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ اَلْفِ شَهْرٍۗ
ayahs.textEnglish: The Night of Destiny is better than a thousand months:

ayahs.textArabic: تَنَزَّلُ الْمَلٰۤىِٕكَةُ وَالرُّوْحُ فِيْهَا بِاِذْنِ رَبِّهِمْۚ مِنْ كُلِّ اَمْرٍۛ
ayahs.textLatin: Tanazzalul-malā'ikatu war rūḥu fīhā bi'iżni rabbihim min kulli amr(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: in hosts descend in it the angels, bearing divine inspiration by their Sustainer's leave; from all [evil] that may happen
does it make secure, until the rise of dawn.
